pages.title: Portable Furnace
pages.text: A tiny magical furnace that works from your inventory. It needs no fuel: the heat it lets escape is enough to smelt items slowly by itself, though at only half the speed of ordinary smelting.

$(bold)Changing its mood$()$(br)Right-click the hakkero while it is in your inventory to cycle through $(bold)OFF → Smoker → Furnace → Blast Furnace$(). Each mode accepts the recipes of that type.$(br2)The hakkero heats the inventory slots right beside it and puts finished results out along the diagonals. Leave room around it for items to move.
